name: Pike Finance re-initialisable spoke implementations
summary: The spoke implementations Pike installed after its earlier incident left initialize() callable on the already initialised proxies. The attacker called initialize() to make its contract owner and upgrader, then upgradeToAndCall() to its own logic, sweeping each spoke's funds on Optimism, Arbitrum and Ethereum.
notes: One attacker EOA hit the three spokes within 35 minutes; Optimism came first. initialize() was already callable after the first post-incident upgrade on Optimism (0x3d48ef4e), but the exploit ran the implementation installed two days later, so that later upgrade is the reset.
The Base hub proxy was re-initialised and upgraded the next day by another address without moving any funds, so it is not in the campaign. The 2024-04-26 CCTP drain is a separate vulnerability.
